release_notes: V14.44 build 251 corrects the local .local alias service by introducing a single-owner mDNS lifecycle. The responder starts only after Wi-Fi has a valid IP address and the local web server is ready, stops when Wi-Fi loses its IP, restarts after reconnection or an alias change, and retries automatically if ready, stops when Wi-Fi loses its IP, restarts after reconnection or an alias change, and registration fails. The Web UI reports the actual alias-service state and includes a manual Restart local alias service control. B250 Web OTA progress, 30-minute chunked trend recovery, local buzzer controls, Nightscout functions, alarms, WhatsApp alerts and existing Leah 2R features remain preserved.
